title: File:The Cypriot Presidential Palace 3.jpg
desc:
The Presidential palace in Nicosia on 13 of May, 2021.
The original building was a prefabricated structure erected in November 1878 on a site known as Snake Hill, on which Richard the Lionheart is said to have set up camp.
